svg.title: Shared-memory bank mappings for plain, padded, and XOR-swizzled transpose tiles
svg.desc: An eight by eight excerpt shows the bank selected by each logical matrix coordinate. A highlighted logical column maps to one repeated bank in the plain layout and to distinct banks in the padded and swizzled layouts.
svg.text: One warp reads shared-memory column c = 3
first 8 of 32 lanes shown · each cell is a bank ID
